title: An Agentic Evaluation Architecture for Historical Bias Detection in Educational Textbooks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a multi-agent LLM architecture that flags candidate excerpts, explicitly categorizes them as authorial narrative or primary source usage, and assesses them using a 7-point severity scale and a 15-label taxonomy (including selection bias, structural omission, and teleological narrative).
Measured by having a jury of heterogeneous evaluative LLMs identify nationalist myth-making, ethno-nationalist essentialism, and national centering within textbook narratives.
Assessed by detecting Eurocentric framing and cultural perspective limitations in historical texts using an automated agentic evaluation pipeline.
